title: Brand UI Kit Library
description: Turn brand into a publishable UI library: Radix + Tailwind + shadcn used only inside brand; ship React primitives and a generated CSS bundle; FE must not depend on Tailwind.
acceptance: A library build emits React UI components and a generated CSS bundle.
Initial primitives are available: Button, Select, Card, Table, Badge, Skeleton, and Alert.
Component theme is bridged from existing brand design tokens.
Brand Studio (or a dedicated lab) can preview the primitives.
Public package exports for the UI kit and CSS are documented.
A consumer can import the components and CSS without installing Tailwind.

title: Visual Definitions Index
description: Add a navigable index/README for Reading and Analysis visual-definition stacks under knowledge/visual-definitions/, and align ui-philosophy terminology to Symbol (not Asset) so SoT language matches domain language and terminology.
acceptance: An index or README under knowledge/visual-definitions/ lists the Reading document stack and the Analysis document stack with short roles for each file.
ui-philosophy.md uses Symbol (not Asset) as the protagonist term, consistent with domain-language and terminology.
Cross-links from the index reach reading-model, reading-composition-model, reading-layout-blueprint, reading-layout-specification, and the analysis/ subtree docs.
No hi-fi Figma or FE implementation work is required for this Feature.
